sensor_profile.extrinsics_status: Existing mount positions retained by user request; not hardware-calibrated

camera.model_limit: Ideal pinhole + geometric depth; no active-stereo matching, emitter, multipath or calibrated noise

lidar.model_limit: Procedural nonrepeating angular coverage approximation, not the proprietary Livox scan trajectory; idealized reflectivity-independent 70m cap

imu.model_limit: Physics sensor, ideal noise-free gyro and specific force; IMU-to-LiDAR transform assumed identity, orientation unavailable on ROS

scene_sources.lidar_backend: Warp CUDA exact collision mesh ray queries, instantaneous 20k-ray scans at 10Hz; no proprietary motion-distortion or reflectance model
scene_sources.metric_source: 839873_collision.usd triangles -> Warp CUDA pinhole depth and LiDAR; authored PhysX colliders for contacts; no Gaussian geometry or synthetic ground in metric queries

renderer.coordinate_frame: NuRec raw tensor XYZ, same unrotated metre/Z-up frame as collision mesh; USD display-axis conversion intentionally omitted
renderer.limits: Same NuRec Gaussians and SH3, rendered with gsplat rather than the original 3DGRUT unscented/ray renderer. Robot mesh is not composited into Gaussian RGB.
